notes.title: There are more cars on the road
notes.content:
Added a stage where you can eat sandwiches while avoiding cars quickly.

When you advance the calendar to August, a car appears on the course

If you approach the car from behind, it will stall.

If you avoid from behind, you will be able to temporarily obtain items in a wide area.

It also makes you temporarily invincible to falling cats.
